ground_truth.source: MITRE CTID Mappings Explorer, CISA KEV to ATT&CK

metric_definitions.averaging: macro average over CVEs; n is the number of CVEs averaged
metric_definitions.hit_at_k: 1 if any of the top-k retrieved identifiers is in the ground truth
metric_definitions.mrr: reciprocal rank of the first relevant identifier within the top 3, else 0
metric_definitions.exact: identifier equality, sub-techniques distinct from parents
metric_definitions.parent_collapsed: both sides truncated to the parent technique, then de-duplicated
metric_definitions.all_cves: ground-truth identifiers absent from the corpus count as misses
metric_definitions.excluding_gt_absent_from_corpus: CVEs whose ground truth has no identifier in the corpus are removed

popularity_baseline.description: Constant prediction of the three most frequently mapped techniques among the evaluated CVEs; fitted on the evaluated CVEs themselves, which favours the baseline.
